title: Interest accrual instruction succeeded [Beta]
description: This event occurs when an interest accrual instruction is successfully processed with product interest engine. With reversal true, the non-capitalized accrued interest already published as accrual is reversed. With reversal false, nothing is changed and the same amounts are only reported.

external_account_id.title: External account ID
external_account_id.description: Client-provided external account ID used for external system integration

instruction_id.title: Instruction ID
instruction_id.description: Client-provided instruction ID, unique within the organization and program

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Free-text reason passed in the instruction

interest_net_amount.title: Interest net amount
interest_net_amount.description: Account-level net non-capitalized accrued interest already published as accrual, within the instruction scope. Rounded half-up to 2 decimal places, and 0 when there is none.

interest_gross_amount.title: Interest gross amount
interest_gross_amount.description: Account-level gross non-capitalized accrued interest already published as accrual, within the instruction scope. Rounded half-up to 2 decimal places, and 0 when there is none.

division_id.title: Division ID
division_id.description: Division ID. Present only when passed in the instruction.

division_code.title: Division code ID
division_code.description: Code string that uniquely identifies the division within your organization. Present only when passed in the instruction.

created_at.title: Created date
created_at.description: UTC date and time the instruction was processed, as an ISO local date-time without offset.
